en: No one can defy their own desires.
In that state, you'll join our side sooner or later without us lifting a finger.
We'll meet again, Prince of Darkness. I'll be waiting.
Ha ha ha ha ha.
Wait...!
Skeleton
Going to see your father, are you?
You...
Ha ha ha, what a menacing look.
And here I came to invite you most courteously.
...I'll kill every last vampire.
A shame that you, of the king's blood, should have such a heart.
Perhaps I should have killed you back then after all.
Shut up!
Hmm. Well, very well.
Then allow me to test whether you're worthy of going to the king.
As expected of the king's son... the strength of your blood is splendid...
But you're still far from Lord Ravenruft's power.
You'll end up kneeling before your father.
Ha ha ha ha...
You're a hero who carries Vastir's blood...
Vastir?
One of the heroes who set the world's chaos right a thousand years ago...
Though... he has fallen into darkness now and calls himself Ravenruft...
...Ravenruft?
Yes... As a swordsman, he fought Satan's Heavenly Dragon...
But he was drenched in the Heavenly Dragon's blood then, and took on a cursed fate...
His fate is a sad one...
That has nothing to do with me... He's just the one I'm going to kill...
Yes... But you may be the only one who can save him from the curse...
Defeat him, and free his soul from its cursed body...
I'll kill him for my own sake. I've no interest in anything else...
Clive, will you hear me out?
What...
Do you know of Vastir's sword?
...I have no interest in that.
His sword was a special sword, blessed by an angel.
I don't think Vastir, who has become a Demon Lord, still has it.
Where that sword is now... I don't know.
Please, find it. The sword will surely give you strength.
We meet again.
Who are you? I don't remember you...
I'm Cecia, the one who inherited the memories of the Holy Mother of the forest.
We, called the Holy Mothers of the Reyforia Forest, give all our memories to our successors so the memories of a thousand years ago are never lost.
Such a thing is possible...
Clive... have you met Vastir?
No, not yet...
I see...
Clive, have you heard of Vastir's sword?
No, I don't know of it.
I don't think Vastir, who has become a Demon Lord, still has it.
So where that sword is now, I don't know...
Clive... please, find it. The sword will surely give you strength.
And defeat him, and free his soul from its cursed body...
I'll... kill him for my own sake. I've no interest in anything else...
Yes... I've met him... But I haven't beaten him.
Clive, you have finally defeated Ravenruft.
He was... a man who bore a tragedy... Forced to obey the devil's blood, he had to die as a fiend...
Once, he spoke of the time he lost to his blood... How he came to be king of the undead.
Will you tell me...? He died without saying a thing...
Very well. I'll tell you of that sad and terrible event.
Vastir, who had endured the terror of his blood for so long, met a woman in his centuries of solitude, and fell in love.
She was a beautiful woman who loved him just the same, even after he told her all his secrets.
Vastir and she married, and a child was born to them.
With her, he forgot the terror of his blood and lived in peace.
But even in that tranquil life, the devil's blood quietly, slowly took hold of him.
And on a bright night of the full moon, tragedy struck.
Vastir sank his poisoned fangs into the wife and child he loved most... unable to resist the hunger of his blood...
When morning came and he saw the sin he had committed, his heart shattered...
And so Ravenruft was born.
That was centuries ago now... The long years changed everything about him.
But now that is over too. His soul has finally been set free.
Thank you... Clive, it's thanks to you.
He and I were comrades who fought together. Please, let me thank you...
Warrior, you have done well to come this far.
Are you... Vastir...?
Vastir? That's not my name.
Of course... that couldn't be...
But you look so very much like him... like Vastir...
Only a very few can enter this place. Those led by an angel, for example...
Where have you come from?
I came here led by the angel, from the frontier of Courrege, far to the north...
Then you know the name Ravenruft, don't you?
You know him?
Yes, I know him, but you and Ravenruft are...
...my sworn enemy.
I see... Then I must tell you.
The true name of the man who now calls himself Ravenruft is Vastir.
A thousand years ago, the swordsman Vastir fought alongside us as a hero, led by an angel...
As a brave swordsman he came through many battles, and in the end, we defeated the Heavenly Dragon.
But in that battle with the Heavenly Dragon, he was drenched in its blood.
The first few years seem to have passed without him noticing, but then Vastir grew suspicious of his body, which did not age...
As he pondered the reason, he realized he had been tainted by cursed blood...
He shunned people, enduring madness and solitude for centuries.
But a certain sad event turned him into what he is now... Ravenruft, king of the undead.
...So he...
Your appearance... Could it be that you have inherited the blood of Vastir... of Ravenruft?
Then you too feel the terror of the blood...
Just as I could not understand his feelings back then, I cannot fully understand your pain.
But please, endure it. You must not give in to the madness of the blood...
The angel who is there with you will surely guide you down the right path...
Please... believe that.
May heaven bless him...
You, what are you...
It's none of your business!
...Please, hold on.
Clive... the Demon Stone has been taken.
Clive... please, protect the world as Vastir did. And be a help to the angel...
You...
Hold on...
So you've come.
Have you decided to kneel before me?
As if I'd... ever kneel to you.
Hmm, I see. So my invitation to the banquet was wasted.
But simply sending you away would be tasteless. Keep these women company.
Let me see your skill. Ha ha ha ha ha.
Medusa
I've been waiting, my son.
The banquet is prepared. Come to me. I shall welcome you as the Prince of Darkness.
As if I'd... ever come to you... I'm going to kill you...
Ha ha ha, I see.
So my invitation to the banquet was wasted. Well, it can't be helped.
Hmph, good skill. Worthy of my child.
...Ngh, I can't move...
With your power as it is, you can't even come near me.
I'll grant you your spirit in resisting your blood...
But defying my blood is futile. Sooner or later, you too will join our side.
Ngh... I'll never yield to your blood, even if it kills me!!
Heh, very well. Now, go. I shall watch you fall.
Wait!! Ravenruft!!!
One day you too will bow before me. Until we meet again.
Wh-what do you want...
Th-this is our land now. We let no humans near.
Wh-why don't you talk? G-get out, or do you want to die?
Here I come...
Mm, mmh. You're after our treasure.
I-I'll kill you!
So you've come, my son.
I've come to kill you...
Ha ha, you? Do you think you have the power?
...I'll kill you!
It seems you haven't noticed... that you've already lost...
What do you mean...
Now, release it... your desire, your rage... your hatred!
